texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Today we're zooming in on animals. Each photo starts super close, then slowly zooms out. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first animal. Any idea?
Yes! It's a Giraffe. Giraffes are the tallest animals on Earth.
Take a good look. Which animal is this?
That's a Zebra. Every zebra has its own unique stripe pattern.
Easy one... or is it? Name this animal!
It's a Tiger. The tiger is the largest wild cat in the world.
Eyes on the screen. What animal do we have here?
Correct answer: a Lion. A lion's roar can be heard up to eight kilometres away.
You've seen this one before. Which animal?
Of course, it's an Elephant. Elephants are the largest land animals alive today.
Quick! Which animal is this?
Boom! It's a Penguin. Emperor penguins can dive more than 500 metres deep.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: a Panda. Giant pandas spend up to 14 hours a day eating bamboo.
Don't overthink it. Which animal is this?
You got it, it's a Koala. Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day.
This one is a classic. Which animal?
Spot on! It's a Kangaroo. Kangaroos can't walk backwards.
Last easy one! Which animal is this?
The answer is a Polar bear. Under its white fur, a polar bear has black skin.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which animal is this?
Yes! It's a Flamingo. Flamingos get their pink colour from the food they eat.
Look closely at the details. Which animal?
That's a Cheetah. The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this animal!
It's a Peacock. Only male peafowl have the spectacular tail.
This one fools a lot of people. Which animal is it?
Correct answer: a Hippopotamus. Hippos can't really swim. They walk along the river bottom.
Can you get this one right? Which animal?
Of course, it's a Chameleon. Chameleons can move each eye on its own.
Think carefully. What animal is this?
Boom! It's an Octopus. An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: a Toucan. Its huge beak is surprisingly light.
Got it already? Which animal is this?
You got it, it's a Sloth. Sloths can take weeks to digest a single meal.
Keep that streak going! Which animal?
Spot on! It's a Red panda. Red pandas spend most of their life in trees.
Last medium question! Which animal is this?
The answer is a Meerkat. Meerkats take turns standing guard for the group.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which animal is this?
Yes! It's an Okapi. Despite its stripes, its closest relative is the giraffe.
Not so easy now. Which animal?
That's an Axolotl. Axolotls can regrow lost limbs.
Here's one for the experts. Name this animal!
It's a Pangolin. It is covered in scales and rolls into a ball when threatened.
Take your time... but not too much. Which animal?
Correct answer: a Capybara. It is the largest rodent in the world.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which animal is it?
Of course, it's a Tapir. Tapirs use their short trunk to grab leaves.
Big brain time! What animal is this?
Boom! It's a Mandrill. Mandrills are the largest monkeys in the world.
Lock in your answer! Which animal?
Here it is: a Snow leopard. It uses its long thick tail as a scarf in the cold.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's a Platypus. It is a mammal that lays eggs.
Are you still with me? Which animal is this?
Spot on! It's a Lemur. Wild lemurs live only on the island of Madagascar.
Last hard one! Which animal?
The answer is a Narwhal. Its long tusk is actually a tooth.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which animal is this?
Yes! It's an Aye-aye. It taps on trees with a long thin finger to find insects.
Seriously tough now. Name this animal!
That's a Shoebill. This giant bird has a huge bill shaped like a shoe.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which animal?
It's a Fossa. The biggest predator of Madagascar.
Deep cut! Which animal is this?
Correct answer: a Quokka. Often called the happiest animal in the world because it looks like it's smiling.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's a Saiga antelope. Its large flexible nose helps it filter dust and cold air.
No hints this time. Which animal?
Boom! It's a Star-nosed mole. It has 22 tentacles on its nose.
Almost there! Which animal is this?
Here it is: a Proboscis monkey. Males have a very large nose.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which animal?
You got it, it's a Gharial. Its long thin snout is perfect for catching fish.
Second to last! Name this animal!
Spot on! It's a Kakapo. The world's only flightless parrot, from New Zealand.
Final question! Make it count. Which animal is this?
The answer is a Maned wolf. It looks like a fox on stilts, but it's neither a fox nor a wolf.
That's the last animal! How many did you spot? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
